title: OP Script YES
features:
AUTO FEATURES
• Auto Collect - Automatically collects items from plots
• Auto Upload - Automatically uploads content
• Auto Claim - Automatically claims rewards
• Auto Submit - Automatically submits content
REBIRTH FEATURES
• Smart Auto Rebirth - Automatically rebirths with the highest affordable amount
UPGRADE FEATURES
• Auto Upgrades - Automatically buys upgrades (views, luck, viral chance, rebirth buttons, upload time)
• Youtuber ID Input - Text box to enter Youtuber ID
• Auto Buy Youtuber - Automatically buys the selected Youtuber
• Sell All Youtubers - Button to sell all Youtubers at once
EGG HATCHING
• Auto Bulk Hatch - Automatically opens event eggs in batches of 10,000
TELEPORT FEATURES
• Auto Floor Cycle - Automatically cycles through 6 different floor positions every 10 seconds
BACKGROUND FEATURES
• Egg Animation Removal - Disables egg opening animations (runs automatically on startup)
